title: Android Editor crash related to switching to Script Editor (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable in the Android editor on Google Play
- Didn't check for reports on earlier versions

### System information

Android 15, Infinix GT 30 Pro

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.
For now it's crashing only for one user, but we just released 4.6, more reports will likely come up.

Report for maintainers with access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/0d033d535239bf8efc752c2bb6e30022/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500
